body: I see the same problem also.
i think this is a duplicate of #1068

It looks like the process exited in an unusual way and PM2 didn't receive the 'exit' signal.
I just released PM2 0.12.8 in which I have refactored a bit the stop/restart procedure.
Can you guys give it a try ?

issue.title: v0.12.8 Release

repository.name: pm2
repository.description: Node.js Production Process Manager with a built-in Load Balancer.

issue.body:
#0.12.8 (Current Stabe)
- Fix : `Channel closed error`
- Fix : `Resource leak error`
- Fix #1091 : when passing a wrong formated number to `-i` infinite loop
- Fix #1068 #1096 : restart fails after reloadLogs()
- New : When PM2 is being killed, all restarts are blocked to avoid conflict
- New : PM2 dumps the process list before exiting if it is killed by signal
- Refactored stop/restart for better stability
